description: This file defines the class 'HTMLPurifier_AttrDef_CSS_Background' which handles validation of the CSS 'background' shorthand property within the HTMLPurifier library. It includes logic for parsing, validating, and assembling the background property components.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_AttrDef_CSS_Background
